title: The Unpleasantness at the Bellona Club
description: A mystery surrounding the sudden death of General Alok at the Bellona Club on Armistice Day, and the subsequent investigation into the exact time of his death due to conflicting wills left by his sister, Lady Disha.
intro_narrative: On Armistice Day, General Alok is found dead in his usual armchair at the Bellona Club. The discovery of his death coincides with the death of his estranged sister, Lady Disha. The exact timing of General Alok's death becomes crucial due to conflicting wills that determine the distribution of Lady Disha's substantial fortune. Lord Bhumi Swara is tasked with uncovering the truth behind the General's death and the mysterious circumstances surrounding it.

required_evidence: General Alok's notes about money distribution
Chemical apparatus and medical books in Miss Kavya's studio
Portrait of a man resembling Dr. Udita
Analysis of varnish from General Alok's left boot
required_motive: Financial gain from Lady Disha's will
Concealment of General Alok's true time of death
